summary: Cover of Rap Masters magazine, issue price $2.95 US / $3.50 Canada / GBP 1.75 UK, cover-dated November 1992. A full-bleed photograph of the duo Kris Kross fills the centre-right of the cover, with the red-and-yellow banner "Exclusive! KRIS KROSS MINI-MAG!!" set directly above and overlapping it, so Kris Kross is both the cover photograph and the subject of the advertised mini-mag. Also on the cover: a "Who's Hot Now?" sidebar of three stacked panels and a "Hip-Hop Style for the '90s" cover line, plus a bottom photo strip of captioned acts.
